senses.gloss:
वाढ वाढ, अस्, आ, अम् (probably the origi-
nal form of ऊढ, past part. of rt. 1. वह्; compar.
साधीयस्, superl. साधिष्ठ, q. q. v. v.; cf. बहु,
वहल), hard, firm; much, abundant, excessive, ex-
ceeding; (अम्), ind. much, excessively; indeed,
truly; very well, very good, well, yes, indeed, truly,
surely, positively; consequently.
—वाढ-विक्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, of excessive prowess, powerful, very
strong, mighty.
